headline.label: Housing completions
headline.sentence: Housing completions in Zaragoza fell 79% over the year to 2025-Q4.

regime.label: Pressure without supply
regime.reading: Rents and prices are running above this city's own record while starts and completions are not responding. Pressure here is a supply problem rather than a demand surge, and it does not resolve on its own.

top_signature.label: Overheating
top_signature.summary: The boom's second act: prices and short-term-rental supply keep climbing while the things that fund them stop. Transactions and permits roll over first, and the storefront churn rate rises before net closures do.

regime.label: Hot
regime.reading: Housing pressure is well above this city's own history and has not yet turned. Supply is at least keeping pace, so this is heat rather than a squeeze.
